environment: Owasco Lake, New York; natural lake, one near-surface EXO 1 sonde, not the whole water column
windowMeaning: One fixed28day window in the next calendar month, selected before reading its observations or results; no alternative window after acquisition failures or unfavorable outcomes. Inclusive source query endpoints; exact origin grid unchanged.

sourceChoice.basis: Official metadata and methods only, not candidate performance; both series are Primary instantaneous EXO 1 measurements
sourceChoice.catalogueDescriptor: EXO 1; Depth at 3 feet for both oxygen and temperature
sourceChoice.depthCaveat: USGS SIR 2024-5010 table describes the near-surface Owasco deployment at 0.76 m, while the catalogue descriptor says 3 feet. Preserve both labels; do not claim an independently verified exact depth. Do not mix EXO 2/3 or thermistor-chain series
sourceChoice.samplingEvidence: USGS SIR 2024-5010 reports multiparameter-sonde measurements every 15 minutes; catalogue data_gap_interval PT1H12M is a gap-detection threshold, not sampling cadence
sourceChoice.providerMeaning: A new ecosystem and geography using the same USGS provider; not independent-provider corroboration

development.meaning: Chosen exclusively on already-inspected Willamette development data; weights, standardization and threshold stay fixed on the lake

featurePolicy: Same eight inputs, ordering, UTC clock and coefficients; no local-time correction, re-centering, fitting, tuning or new variables using lake data

eligibility.history: Twelve exact consecutive half-hour oxygen and temperature records ending at each UTC :00/:30 origin, plus exact oxygen target one hour later
eligibility.quality: Exact station, time-series identity, instantaneous statistic 00011 and units; Approved, unqualified and finite values; nonnegative oxygen; reject duplicate IDs/times, pagination or truncated collections
eligibility.missingData: No interpolation, averaging, filling or selective dropping by forecast error; unused quarter-hour records remain in the raw archive
eligibility.discharge: No lake discharge input and no fabricated zero flow. Discharge was a Willamette cohort requirement, not one of the frozen eight model features. The lake cohort explicitly requires oxygen and temperature only
eligibility.screenMeaning: Practical completeness screen, not power, instrument accuracy or ecological validation

primaryMetric: MAE in mg/L on the identical accepted origin-target cohort

uncertainty.seedRule: seed plus block hours, Python Random MT19937
uncertainty.meaning: Paired calendar-block bootstrap of persistence-minus-filter absolute error; conditional exploratory intervals, not prediction intervals or independent confirmations

decision.success: Completeness passes, finite nonnegative filter predictions, lower MAE than persistence, and positive lower exploratory paired gain bounds for all three block lengths

freezeOrder: Commit and push exact new protocol and adapter/tests plus unchanged pinned kernels before the first August measurement request. Exclusive single attempt; preserve failed responses; no automatic retry or alternative window. Do not modify July protocol or evaluation.
scope: Exploratory retrospective temporal evaluation on one uninspected-in-this-workflow August2020near-surface Owasco window, using unchanged Willamette2024model and fixed gate; not independent environmental truth or operational deployment.
mission: Verifiable environmental evidence supporting communities and youth; no change to operational Oracle, governance, quorum, treasury, token, spending or automatic interventions

previousPrimaryEvaluation.role: Historical context only; never pooled into the new primary score or used to tune model/threshold.

dataSeparation.claim: Not previously inspected for forecast evaluation in this workflow, subject to a local cache/provenance check before capture; not absolute blindness of every human or pretrained model.
dataSeparation.season: One further summer window, not all-season or independent-provider validation.
dataSeparation.acquisitionPurpose: New temporal evidence with the existing fixed model and gate; not new training or threshold development.
dataSeparation.asOfOriginLimit: Finalized historical archives do not establish the values or revision state available at issuance time. Model trained2024 applied2020; not a historical live simulation.
